phases.objective: Remove two cumulative-diff blockers exposed only when current main is compared with the older Production baseline, without weakening OpenAPI conflict detection or restoring a retired evidence publisher.

e2e_journeys.actor: Protected Production promotion Artifact refresher and E2E phase evaluator
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Precise OpenAPI registry sync and Hostinger Tenant Canary evidence contract
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The known completion-certification legacy inline operation is replaced by its exact registered static path-item reference, malformed or unrelated inline contracts remain blocked, and the Tenant Canary contract references the current generic evidence publisher rather than a deleted specialized workflow.
steps: Load a registered Support Ticket completion-certification path whose root OpenAPI operation predates runtime metadata fields.
Require the exact allowlisted signature, operationId, admin security profile, consequential flag, response contract, and absence of incompatible source/completeness metadata.
Replace the entire inline path item with the precise registry `$ref` only when every exact condition passes.
Reject wrong operationId, wrong security, conflicting source metadata, and unrelated paths with the existing precise-contract conflict code.
Verify the Hostinger Tenant Canary context contract uses the generic CI evidence publisher and routing registry.
Preserve all runtime, provider, migration, deployment, Production, and credential boundaries.
assertions: Only `POST /admin/support/tickets/{ticket_id}/external-delivery/completion-certification` is eligible for the legacy registered-path transition.
Security must remain the exact admin bearer or backend API key profile and the operation must remain consequential.
Any malformed metadata or unrelated path remains `registered_path_inline_contract_not_replaceable`.
A successful write produces the exact static `$ref` and zero remaining registry/runtime conflicts.
The retired `.github/workflows/hostinger-ci-evidence-pr-publisher.yml` is absent from the repaired evidence paths.
The current `.github/workflows/ci-evidence-pr-publisher.yml` and `.github/ci-evidence-routing.json` remain required evidence.
No SQL, migration authorization or Apply, activation registry synchronization, provider call, credential access, deployment, restart, Production ref mutation, or external send occurs.

phases.objective: Run Protected Promotion Generated Artifact Refresh against a non-merge Production comparison PR and record the generated precise OpenAPI replacement.
Keep registered inline conflicts fail-closed while preventing future references to retired evidence publisher workflows.
Rebuild and validate a fresh source-pinned Production candidate after the repair is merged to main.
Promote only an explicitly authorized exact candidate after all cumulative generated-artifact and E2E checks pass.
